credits.title: Love in a Hopeless Place
credits.overview: Modern dating sucks. Deidre is looking for love but she also has the luxury of feeding off them when they don't work out.

credits.title: Sweetness
credits.overview: When a chance encounter with her rockstar crush leads 16-year-old Rylee to discover that he's a dysfunctional drug addict, she takes it upon herself to help him, ultimately forcing her teenage fantasies into reality.

credits.title: Shrimp Fried Rice
credits.overview: A talented shrimp chef with an ego that outweighs his tiny body carries out his vendetta against a certain culinary inclined rat which puts The Shrimp’s human puppet at risk of deportation.

credits.title: FruitHead
credits.overview: FruitHead explores the sinister backstory of Gushers commercial origins, uncovering a new side to the story that has never been seen before.

credits.title: Maybe It's You
credits.overview: Best friends Peter and Lexa decide to try the one thing they’ve never tried: dating each other.

credits.title: In the Heat
credits.overview: When a bruised and battered man claiming to be Santa Clause is arrested for the murder of a child, the interrogating officers uncover a story more bizarre and horrific than expected.

credits.title: The Holiday Swap
credits.overview: When two strangers mistakenly pick up the wrong piece of luggage at the airport, each must use the intriguing contents within to track down the other's whereabouts in time for Christmas.

credits.title: Wedding Season
credits.overview: Pressured by their immigrant parents to find spouses, two Indian-Americans pretend to date in order to survive a summer of weddings – but find themselves falling for each other as they struggle to balance who they are with who their parents want them to be.

credits.title: May Flowers
credits.overview: A misunderstanding occurs when Jimmy goes to pick up an order for his boss at May Flowers. Little did he expect how the tables would turn.
